decisions.reason: fs-ext@2.1.1 pinned by dsh-session-persistence-jsonl; install script node-gyp configure build; configure aborts on missing VS/MSVC; correctly attributed to the dependency/build phase, not pnpm or network.
Top-level flock import forces module resolution on Windows; --ignore-scripts skips the build but leaves the entry unloadable (MODULE_NOT_FOUND at load), so it cannot yield a working boot.

Distinguishes acquireLockHandleWin32 named kernel semaphore from POSIX flock with branch meaning; Windows stub justified by dead flock path; semaphore must stay, POSIX keeps real flock, semaphore removal explicitly rejected.

Uses the node-pty pnpm-patch precedent with install-script no-op, callable pure-JS entry fallback, registration and reinstall/load checks; but the sketched patch is not platform-guarded, so non-Windows would also lose the native build, and build permissions are unaddressed.
Respects no-Visual-Studio constraint (explicitly rejected), uses repository-managed patchedDependencies rather than changing upstream fs-ext or the published package.
Report never cites DSH-0.1.3-A1-03 or any corridor card.

caps.reason: VS/MSVC install explicitly listed under 'do not do'.
--ignore-scripts explicitly rejected as insufficient; entry-loadability addressed.
Plan uses pnpm patchedDependencies patch files in the plugin repository, not upstream edits or releases.
Windows semaphore retained as the correctness mechanism; fallback throws rather than universally no-op'ing locks; semaphore deletion explicitly rejected.
